resolution.note: backlog triage 2026-11-07: Improves retired delivery ceremony (briefs/review/verify/slice/deliver/worker/red-first/hardening checklist)

title: Lock deliver per PR and resume after merge
body: Outcome: `krn deliver` takes a per-PR lock so a second run while one is live exits with a clear "deliver already running pid <n>" instead of racing, and a resume after the PR merged continues with main CI and hygiene instead of exiting 76 "PR is not open". Evidence: PR #189, session restart left deliver pid 1702827 running; the resumed run printed `PR is not open` exit 76 (.krn/runs/lead/worker-acceptance/deliver-2.txt) while the first finished `delivered: e35a666`. Proof: observer red at base by assertion for both cases.
